entries.en:
Convinced of the merits of Chaqurl Qhotl's argument, you express your support for his theory that the Qitari sought to share their food supply with the suffering catfish people, before the latter tribe's unfortunate disappearance from the forest. Grudgingly agreeing that his son may have a point, the stubborn Qitari agrees to assist in the restoration of the third stela.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Under your watchful eye, the Qitari artisans restore the third stela to Chaqurl Qhotl's best interpretation of its former glory. Encouraged and heartened by reclaiming yet another vital piece of their legacy, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Continue to lend them your aid in their efforts should you so desire.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl célèbrent la restauration de la troisième stèle légendaire. Mais les fouilles ne sont pas terminées pour autant !
entries.ja: ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、「第三の石碑」の復元完了を、とても喜んでいるようだ。これからも、キタリ族の発掘を手伝っていこう！

entries.en: Father may interpret the markings differently, but I am certain that my ancestors were not so cruel and violent as he would say. When famine struck the forest, we Qitari took pity on the catfish people, and shared with them our freshest catches!
entries.fr: souuutenir théorie de Chaqurl Qhotl ?  aussi penser que Qitari partager nourriture avec gentils hommes-poissons-chats ?
entries.ja:
そるかしの考えた、キタリ族による「ナマズ獣人救済説」、
よいと思ってくださるでござうか？

entries.en: That they vanished from the Greatwood after this is a pity, but I know that our forefathers did all they could to save their slippery little friends. This is most definitely, most in-tubit-ably the case, do you not agree?

entries.en: If you vouch for Chaqurl Qhotl's theory, the third stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Qitarl Natl envisions it.
entries.fr: Si vous choisissez de soutenir la théorie de Chaqurl Qhotl, la stèle des Qitari sera restaurée selon cette hypothèse. Vous ne pourrez pas voir la version proposée par Qitarl Natl.
entries.ja:
「チャクルリ・コテル」の説を信じてストーリーを進行させると、
彼の説に基づき、石碑の復元が行われるようです。
「キタルリ・ナトル」の説での復元結果を見ることはできません。

entries.en: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
entries.fr: Les récompenses que vous obtiendrez seront les mêmes dans les deux cas. Suivez donc vos convictions pour faire ce choix.

なお、どちらを進行しても、得られるアイテムや、

あなたが語られるべきと思う歴史を、選択してください。
